avoid_for: High-saturation e-commerce marketplaces, data-dense dashboards or analytics products, dark-mode-first interfaces, and any context needing a loud filled CTA — the muted pastels and flat hairline system read as a considered directory, not a promotional storefront.
best_for: Design-studio / curated project directories, membership and community launch pages, and catalog-style listings that want a quiet editorial register — off-white canvas, large light-weight headlines, and three pastel status cards doing the structural work.
name: Huddle
palette_voice: Paper White (#ffffff) canvas with Ink Black (#151515) text, plus a fixed taxonomy of three muted pastel card fills (pale sage, lavender mist, dusty rose) that function as category tiles; Deep Violet (#453b60) marks the live/active state and a single warm-on-warm pairing (Burnt Amber #65451d border + Honey Gold #e4b976 text on tags) is the only place gold appears — never as a filled CTA; no saturated accents, no box-shadows, separation via 1px hairlines and background contrast.
signature_moves: Three pastel card colors (sage/lavender/dusty rose) as a fixed status taxonomy — one color per project status, never mixed within a card
A deliberate radius vocabulary: 100px pill tags and secondary buttons, 8px cards, 1000px reserved for the single primary button — corner treatment is the hierarchy
All-caps bullet/step-number micro-labels ('• STEP 1: THE BRIEF') in 12px Nng as the primary wayfinding device
Burnt-amber border + honey-gold text on tag pills — the only warm highlight pair, reserved for emphasis
1px hairline borders instead of box-shadows — the system is flat by design, elevation via color contrast
tagline: Pastel inventory cards on cream paper
typographic_voice: One custom geometric sans (Nng, subst. Inter/Söhne) carries the entire hierarchy — display headlines at 44–69px weight 300–400 with tight negative tracking (-0.021em at 69px) read dense and poster-like rather than airy; all-caps 12px micro-labels in weight 500 label the system; bold display (600+) is forbidden, no serifs, no decorative faces, mono only for code-like identifiers.
